name: claude-code-harness
description: Mechanical guards for Claude Code: a permission guard against prompt injection, an end-of-turn budget gate, and an auto-compaction counter. Python standard library only.

plugins.name: harness-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse permission guard (writes/reads outside the project, installs, key leaks, sends to unlisted hosts, edits to the guard itself), a Stop-hook budget gate for unattended runs, and a PreCompact counter. No dependencies.
